grid.title: Pick where you study. We'll handle the rest.

how.eyebrow: Three steps. That's the whole thing.

how.title: Three steps from signup to exam day
how.s1d: Sign up in seconds, pick your year and subjects, and let Vault personalize your study plan.
how.s2d: Answer questions, review explanations, and bookmark tricky topics for spaced repetition.
how.s3d: Track improvement over time, take mock exams, and walk into the real test fully prepared.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
features.f1d: Thousands of clinically relevant questions organized by subject, organ system, and difficulty — written and reviewed by faculty.
features.f2d: Timed, full-length practice tests that mirror the structure and rigor of your university exams, with detailed explanations.
features.f3d: Build custom quizzes from the question bank to target weak areas, review topics, and share study sets with classmates.
